title: polykey pack item
description: One layout, keyboard, theme, table, picker set or language. Files live in packs/<namespace>/; ids are <namespace>/<name>, except a language's, which is its code (its file: packs/<code>/language.json).

name.description: A name: one string, or a name per language code, e.g. {"en": "Smiling", "ja": "笑顔"}.

languageCode.description: A language code: ja, ko, pt-BR.

icon.description: The icon the key draws (src/ui/icons.ts), instead of its default; null: text, never an icon.

parts.description: Two halves side by side, one per mode, the keyboard's own first: on the mode key the current mode's is marked with the indicator bar (한/영); elsewhere the second is bold in 英数 mode (the 12-key's あ a).

marks.description: Marks side by side, each boxed when the layout's dotted lists it (゛゜).

under.description: Drawn small beneath (大⇔小 under ゛゜, the digit under abc).

legendDef.description: Text, null for nothing, or {text | parts | marks, under, size, tone, boxed}; a string is text at the slot's usual size and colour.

legends.description: What goes where on the key, by slot (tl t tr / l c r / bl b br; c is the label). Replaces what the key's other fields put in those slots.

cycles.description: What the modify (゛゜小) key cycles the last typed character through; each string is one cycle, e.g. "はばぱ".

shift.description: Typed with Shift; default: the upper case of char.

long.description: Variants offered on a long press, after the key itself and its Shift variant.

hint.description: A small legend in the top right corner, e.g. the digit a long press offers.

kana.description: A JIS key's kana: typed in かな mode (char and shift are then its Latin legends, typed in 英数 mode).

kanaShift.description: Typed with Shift in かな mode (small kana, punctuation); default: kana.

rows.description: A key two or three rows high, written once in the top row: the rows below leave room for it, in the same columns (less the notch).

notch.description: How much narrower the lower half is, on the left (the JIS Enter: 0.25).

fnKey.description: What the key does while Fn is on.

action.description: What the key does. eisu and kana switch one way into and out of the Latin mode (かな while typing kana also cycles its forms); mode switches between the keyboard's first mode and its Latin mode, reading the letters it goes to.

rows.description: A key two or three rows high, written once in the top row: the rows below leave room for it, in the same columns (less the notch).

notch.description: How much narrower the lower half is, on the left (the JIS Enter: 0.25).

key.description: A one-character string is shorthand for a char key.

toolbar.description: The strip above the keys. Leave it out for the default (settings, emoji, dictate, copy, cut, paste, menu, hide); [] means none.

extends.description: Start from this layout: everything not set here (except name and description) comes from it.

oneOf.description: With extends: the rows to replace, by index from 0 at the top, e.g. {"4": [...]}.

rows.description: Every row, top to bottom. Required unless the layout extends another.

modify.description: What the modify (゛゜小) key does: a table id (e.g. "ja/modify"), or the cycles themselves.

iconSet.description: Which keys draw icons: desktop, or phone (also undo, Enter, ← → and a tag-shaped Backspace; font glyphs render tiny in the headset). Default: phone for a large layout.

arrowStyle.description: Arrow keys as icons where the icon set has them (default), or as text glyphs ←↑↓→.

large.description: Bigger key text and icons, as on a phone 12-key.

dotted.description: Characters drawn in a dotted box wherever they appear as a legend, label or flick hint, as on JIS keycaps (punctuation, ゛゜).

language.description: The keyboard's language: its language pack (kind language) with this code gives what the keyboard leaves out.

extends.description: Start from this keyboard: everything not set here (except name and description) comes from it; a field set here (e.g. options) replaces its.

idleHint.description: Shown where candidates appear while there are none (入力すると、ここに変換候補が出ます). Default: the language pack's.

letters.description: What this mode's letters are called, on the keys back to them (あいう, ABC). Default: the language pack's letters for the first mode, ABC for the Latin one.

latin.description: This is the keyboard's Latin mode (英数).

modes.description: The keyboard's modes, the first its default. None: one mode, its letters named by the language pack, else ABC.

latin.description: The layout shown in 英数 mode instead (the 12-key's ABC keys), or two: the qwertyLatin option picks flick or qwerty. Default: the main layout.

symbols.description: The symbols pages: the symbols key (?123) opens the first, the more-symbols key (=\<) goes between them. Typed in the current mode.

pages.description: The keyboard's other pages; its layout is the main one.

composer.description: How typing composes text in the bar (src/core/composers/). direct: keys type at once. kana: typed kana wait in a reading buffer shown in the bar until confirmed (確定) or converted (変換). romaji: the same buffer; letters become kana with the keyboard's table. hangul-2set: 2-set (두벌식) Hangul, jamo compose into the syllable shown in the bar, sent as it completes, with the keyboard's hangul table.

lexicon.description: Word list for suggestions: packs/<ns>/<name>.tsv (word<TAB>count). On a Japanese keyboard, for its 英数 mode (shown as candidates).

options.description: The options this keyboard offers in settings, with their defaults.

tapCycle.description: Tapping a flick key again goes to its next kana (→ moves on); off: it types the kana again.

candidatesLeft.description: Reading and candidates in a panel left of the keys (fjk), instead of the top bar.

flickHints.description: Show each flick key's other kana small at its edges.

romajiInput.description: A JIS kana keyboard types romaji instead (its Latin legends through the keyboard's table); off: kana input.

qwertyLatin.description: 英数 mode shows the keyboard's qwerty latin page instead of its flick one (the 12-key: QWERTY or flick letters).

swipe.description: Swipe typing: trace a word across the letter keys. Needs features.swipe.

features.description: What the keyboard can do beyond typing keys.

lexicon.description: The word list a swipe is decoded against (packs/<ns>/<name>.tsv).

swipe.description: Swipe typing over the letter keys (the swipe option turns it on and off). On a Japanese keyboard, in its 英数 mode.

converter.description: The engine that converts the reading (with composer kana): anthy, from the system's libanthy.

table.description: The table (kind table) the composer reads, or a kana keyboard's romajiInput option: it must hold the field that composer reads (COMPOSER_TABLES, sidecar/polykey/packs.py).

hover.description: Key under the laser; default modifier.

accentText.description: Text on the accent (a selected candidate, a locked key); default surface.

fnText.description: Text on the Fn colour (Fn locked); default surface.

error.description: Errors (a failed dictation, a pack that did not load); default fnLegend.

divider.description: Hairlines between candidates and sections; default modifier.

ring.description: Outline of an armed modifier, a hovered setting, a selected item; default accent.

indicator.description: Outline marking the current input mode (英数 / かな); default accent.

tone.description: dark (default): pressed and raised states shift lighter; light: they shift darker.

fontCjk.description: Japanese fonts tried first where Japanese is drawn as text; default "Noto Sans CJK JP", "Noto Sans JP".

shadow.description: CSS box-shadow for popups and the drag ghost; default 0 2px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6).

shadowLarge.description: CSS box-shadow for the emoji preview; default 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.6).

followSteam.description: Take colours from Steam's own keyboard theme at runtime.

flick.description: What it types for [tap, flick left, up, right, down]; "" where a direction has nothing. The tap entry is required.

cycle.description: What tapping it again goes through when the keyboard's tapCycle option is on; default: its flick entries.

hints.description: Always show the other directions small at the key's edges, whatever the flick hints option says (e.g. a punctuation key).

sub.description: A small legend beneath the label (the ABC keys' digit); not shown with flick hints.

table.description: A table: entries (romaji to kana), cycles (゛゜小), or hangul (how jamo compose); one of them.

entries.description: [input, output] or [input, output, letters left pending] (kk → っ, k waits).

hangul.description: How jamo compose (composer hangul-2set), what a layout varies: the jamo typed one after the other that make one. The jamo themselves, and their order in Unicode's syllable formula, are Unicode's (src/core/composers/hangul.ts).

compoundMedials.description: Vowels typed one after the other that make one: "ㅗㅏㅘ" is ㅗ then ㅏ, making ㅘ (a medial). Three vowels (ㅏ to ㅣ).

compoundFinals.description: Final consonants typed one after the other that make one: "ㄱㅅㄳ" is ㄱ then ㅅ, making ㄳ (a final). A vowel after it takes the second (닭 + ㅏ → 달 가). Three consonants that can end a syllable (not ㄸ, ㅃ or ㅉ).

language.description: A language: what the keyboards in it call their letters and say in the bar. Keyboards with this code as their language take it; a keyboard's own modes and strings win.

id.description: The language's code (ja, ko); the file is language.json in the folder of that name.

letters.description: What the language's own letters are called (あいう, 한글): the keyboards' first mode, on the keys back to it.

labels.description: The words the bar's keys show while composing, by the names the composer gives them: the kana composer's convert (変換), next (次変換), confirm (確定), and the forms the かな key goes to (hiragana, katakana, halfwidth). confirm is also Enter's while an English word waits in the Latin mode. A name left out leaves the key as it is.

idleHint.description: Shown where candidates appear while there are none, on the keyboards that compose.

dictation.description: The language dictation listens for (default: the id).

font.description: The fonts the bar draws the language's text in, a CSS font-family list tried in order before the theme's font: Korean's is "Noto Sans CJK KR", "Noto Sans CJK JP" (the Frame's system font has no Hangul).

alone.description: What this key becomes when 🌐 is hidden (one keyboard in your list): its width there. The layout's rows must still be as wide as before.

aloneTall.description: What this key becomes when 🌐 is hidden (one keyboard in your list): its width and how many rows high. The layout's rows must still be as wide as before.

pickerText.description: What the picker shows and types: up to 64 characters on one line.

pickerItem.description: One thing to pick: its text; or its text with words that could call it up; or an emoji with its five skin tones.

reading.description: Words in hiragana that could call the item up. Kept by the sidecar.

tags.description: Words that describe the item. Kept by the sidecar.

oneOf.description: [base, light, medium-light, medium, medium-dark, dark]: the tones are offered when the set has "tones": true.

id.description: Unique in its set. recent and favorites are the picker's own.

icon.description: The category's tab. Without one the tab reads its name.

label.description: A divider before the category with a name beside it in the grid: true for the category's name, or another name ("Steam").

apart.description: The category sits apart from the one before: twice the gap, with a divider in it.

oneOf.description: The items are in a data file, for a list too long to write here.

file.description: <namespace>/<name>.data, JSON: {"groups": [{"id": …, "items": […]}]}. A copy in your own packs folder is read instead of the bundled one.

group.description: The group in the file whose items these are; default: the category's id.

oneOf.description: The user's own Steam items of one kind, read from Steam.

picker.description: A set the picker shows (emoji, kaomoji, your own): categories of things to tap and type.

key.description: What the picker's mode key shows when this set is the next one: an icon, or a short text (":-)" for kaomoji).

cells.description: How an item is drawn: as an emoji, or as text on a key in fonts that cover many scripts, shrunk to fit its cell.

cellWidth.description: How wide a cell is, in emoji cells: 1 (the default) for single characters, 2.5 for kaomoji.

recent.description: A Recent section first, with what was last typed from this set.

recentBin.description: A bin in Recent's last place, to empty it. Needs recent.

favorites.description: A Favorites section after Recent, filled by drag and drop from it. Needs recent.

tones.description: Items written with their skin tones offer them when held, and are typed in the tone last chosen.

categories.description: In the order their tabs show. In a pack of yours with a bundled set's id, a category with a bundled category's id replaces it and any other is added after them.
